subject: literature
passage: When the rain started on our walk home from school, my friend Priya opened her large green umbrella and held it over both ______ and herself. We walked the last six blocks pressed close together, splashing through puddles and laughing every time a gust of wind tried to turn the umbrella inside out.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The narrator is the object of the preposition "over" ("over both ______ and herself"). An object needs the object pronoun "me." "Herself" works because Priya is the subject, but the narrator is not the subject of this clause.
explanation.A: Correct. "Me" is the object pronoun needed after the preposition "over."
explanation.B: Incorrect. "I" is a subject pronoun, but the blank is the object of "over."
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Mine" is possessive ("the umbrella is mine"); nothing here is owned by the narrator.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Myself" is reflexive and can be used only when "I" is the subject of the same clause; here the subject is Priya.
